text: Agar stained with universal indicator can be used to investigate diffusion.
When hydrochloric acid diffuses into the agar it changes the colour from green to pink.
You will investigate the diffusion of different concentrations of hydrochloric acid in agar.
You are provided with the materials shown in Table 1.1.
